description: **Caution: Limited reliable information available** - Tetmemorus brebissonii appears to be a single-celled freshwater algae that belongs to a group called desmids. These are microscopic organisms that live in clean ponds, lakes, and slow-moving streams. You would need a microscope to see individual cells, as they are far too small to observe with the naked eye. This is not a typical plant that casual nature explorers would identify in the field.
